thread:
jess: quick heads-up 1 AxiomWave reported rising token spend and occasional 'wrong-entity' answers on finance Qs for /chat. renewal in ~6 weeks. CS health sliding toward yellow. thinking: run an int8 experiment and a model hop for non-critical FAQ routes, plus intent-based routing. any concerns?
ryan-ml: quick read of their telemetry looks promising. top intents: short Q/A ~70%, long summaries ~12%, the rest misc. Q/A traffic is high qps so costs concentrated there. int8 should save but watch entity fidelity.
priya-se: agree on intent routing. propose: route summarization to high-precision model; route FAQ/Q&A to a compact quantized model. Canary plan: phase traffic 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with metric gates.
sam: customer comment from survey: "answers are faster but sometimes lose financial entity formatting". we should build an eval that asserts entity preservation before moving past 25%.
ryan-ml: suggested workflow: 1) produce int8 quantized candidate of current prod for Q/A. 2) onboard compact variant redwood/compact-qa-1.0 for intent:faq. 3) keep full-precision model for summarize & code-gen. Run A/B on entity-F1 + latency.
priya-se: draft routing/canary snippet:```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"match": "intent:faq","model": "redwood/compact-qa-1.0","weight": 0.05},
    {"match": "intent:summarize","model": "redwood/ppx-3.4","weight": 0.95}
  ],
  "rollout": {"phases": ["5m","6h","48h"],"metrics_gate": "entity_f1 > 0.98"}
}
```
jess: good. rough savings if compact-qa handles faq?
ryan-ml: estimate ~28-34% token cost reduction for faq flows; p95 latency 20-35% lower. int8 could add ~10% extra savings but may shave ~0.5-1% off entity-F1 on a small holdout.
sam: flagged to AxiomWave the plan and the rollback policy. they want auto-rollback to full-precision if entity-F1 drops >1.5% in a 1h window.
priya-se: implement fallback chain: compact -> int8 fp fallback -> full-precision. also enable prefix KV caching for repeated FAQ prefixes, example: cache.prefix_ttl=300s.
ryan-ml: i'll build a focused eval harness and run on their infra sample. example command: `./eval_harness --model redwood/compact-qa-1.0 --dataset axiomwave_faq.json --metrics entity_f1,latency_p95`
deploy-bot: created ticket CS-1429 "AxiomWave quant+routing canary" assigned to @ryan-ml, @priya-se, due 2026-01-15. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-1429 :rotating_light:
jess: next steps: ryan run eval and post results, priya make the canary script and route, sam get customer's sign-off on eval set + rollback threshold. i'll draft a renewal playbook note after first canary numbers. :thumbsup:
